name: Packages Coding Agent
summary: The coding-agent package is the core implementation of the Pi coding agent. It provides the agent session runtime, manages model providers and authentication, implements built-in coding tools (bash, edit, read, write, grep, find, ls), handles session persistence, context compaction, and rendering. It includes a TUI-based interactive mode, print/JSON/RPC mode interfaces, and an experimental multi-process client/server architecture. A large set of example extensions demonstrates the extension API, ranging from custom tools and UI overlays to custom provider integrations.
keyPoints: The package implements the Pi coding agent as a monolithic core with an `AgentSession` class orchestrating agent runs, message persistence, and extension event dispatch (src/core/agent-session.ts).
Built-in tools (bash, edit, write, read, grep, find, ls, powershell) are implemented as pluggable definitions with renderers, enabling extension overrides and custom operations (src/core/tools/).

Model runtime abstracts provider composition, OAuth/API-key auth, models.json parsing, and remote provider catalog refresh, supporting numerous providers (src/core/model-runtime.ts, model-config.ts, provider-composer.ts).

Interactive mode provides a full TUI (theme engine, keybindings, selectors, session tree, overlays) and is the primary user interface (src/modes/interactive/), with print/json/rpc modes as alternative frontends.
An experimental client/server and session-worker architecture enables remote/attached sessions and plugin facets, using a coordinator for peer routing (src/experimental/).

The extension system loads .ts/.js modules, caches them per cwd, maps `@earendil-works/pi-*` aliases to bundled modules, and exposes an `ExtensionAPI` with tools, commands, shortcuts, events, and UI context (src/core/extensions/).
Context management includes auto-compaction (token-based, summarization), branch summarization, and cache warming to optimize provider usage (src/core/compaction/, cache-warmer.ts).
Sessions are persisted as versioned JSONL files with a tree structure; the SessionManager handles migration, branching, and rebuilding context (src/core/session-manager.ts).
A package manager resolves, installs, and updates extension/skill/prompt/theme packages from npm or git, integrating with settings (src/core/package-manager.ts).
The package includes extensive example extensions (e.g., custom provider Anthropic/GitLab, plan-mode, subagent, doom overlay) and an SDK example set demonstrating programmatic use (examples/)

entryPoints.name: AgentSession
entryPoints.note: Central session orchestrator: manages agent lifecycle, tools, extensions, compaction, retry, and event emission.

entryPoints.name: main
entryPoints.note: CLI entry point: parses args, resolves sessions, and runs the selected mode (interactive/print/json/rpc).

entryPoints.name: parseArgs
entryPoints.note: Parses command-line arguments into an Args structure with validation.

entryPoints.name: InteractiveMode
entryPoints.note: The interactive TUI mode: renders transcript, editor, footer, and handles keybindings and session commands.

entryPoints.name: createAgentSession
entryPoints.note: SDK entry point to create an agent session programmatically.

entryPoints.name: ModelRuntime
entryPoints.note: Manages model providers, credentials, and model availability; core for streaming and authentication.

entryPoints.name: SessionManager
entryPoints.note: Handles session persistence, tree navigation, and context building from JSONL files.

entryPoints.name: DefaultPackageManager
entryPoints.note: Resolves and installs extension/skill/prompt/theme packages from npm/git sources.

entryPoints.name: createExtensionRuntime
entryPoints.note: Creates the extension runtime context used by loaded extensions.

entryPoints.name: loadExtensions
entryPoints.note: Loads extension modules from paths and initializes them.

entryPoints.name: createToolDefinition
entryPoints.note: Builds tool definitions for built-in tools (read, bash, edit, etc.).

entryPoints.name: buildSystemPrompt
entryPoints.note: Constructs the system prompt from resources, skills, and tool guidelines.

entryPoints.name: runRpcMode
entryPoints.note: Runs the RPC protocol mode for external client control.

entryPoints.name: runPrintMode
entryPoints.note: Runs print mode for non-interactive output pipelines.

entryPoints.name: startServer
entryPoints.note: Starts the experimental persistent server for remote/attached sessions.
